text: Japan's Q2 GDP rose 0.3% quarter over quarter and 1.1% annualized. Exports contributed 0.5 percentage points, while domestic demand subtracted 0.2 points. Consumption and business investment weakened, with public inventories reduced by oil-reserve releases.

meta.note: Public inventories include government oil-reserve releases, complicating the domestic-demand reading.

text: July retail sales rose 0.6% YoY and industrial output 4.5%, both slower than June. Urban investment fell 6.7% YTD, including real estate at -19.2%, while high-tech investment rose 5%. Urban unemployment increased to 5.2%.

meta.note: High-tech investment diverges from contraction across broader fixed-asset categories.

text: Greg Brockman holds product and business responsibilities following Fidji Simo's departure. Dali Rajic replaces Denise Dresser as CRO after Dresser's eight-month tenure. Brad Lightcap also departed. Brockman and Sam Altman remain in leadership positions.

meta.note: Overlapping departures and reassigned functions constrain isolation of a single leadership change.

text: The 30-year Treasury yield reached 5.311%, its highest since June 2007. The 10-year yield rose to 4.724% and the 2-year to 4.182%. The long end remains above shorter maturities as federal deficits and debt issuance remain elevated.

meta.note: Inflation, fiscal borrowing, and issuance pressures coexist; their relative contribution is unresolved.

text: Paramount seeks a $1.88 billion bond from 12 states challenging its $110 billion WBD merger. The transaction remains delayed pending antitrust litigation despite other regulatory approvals. Contract terms add roughly $650 million per quarter after Sept. 30.

meta.note: The bond request and merger injunction occupy the same unresolved antitrust proceeding.

text: Jeanie Buss opposes a sale of the family's 17.8% Lakers stake. Her counsel states that Jeanie, Janie and Joey Buss are co-trustees and that a 2017 court order requires the family's shares to preserve the 15% ownership threshold supporting Jeanie's controlling-owner status.

meta.note: The reported sibling sale position conflicts with Jeanie Buss's asserted controlling and co-trustee authority.
